crossRefs.note: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

parallels.note: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

translations.web: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”
translations.bsb: “Whose image is this,” He asked, “and whose inscription?”
translations.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
translations.asv: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
